name: 911 Inspection Dimensions
description: Reads every PART SKETCH drawing in a folder of nest PDFs and logs each part's dimensions to a text file
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Put the nest package PDFs you want read into one folder (the MOVE TICKET OMIT packets work as-is).
Nothing else to install - the drawing reader is built into TechDeck.
how_it_works: Opens every PDF in the folder and finds the PART SKETCH pages.
Reads the drawing picture on each page and picks out every dimension on it - lengths, radii (R .40), diameters, angles, and snipe sizes like .50 X .50.
Any dimension marked REF is listed separately and is NOT counted as an inspection dimension.
Notes on the drawing (things like '0.375 THK MECHANICAL SQUARE STEEL TUBE') are listed as notes, not dimensions.
Extra view pages that follow a part sketch are read too and rolled into that part.
output: One text file in the folder you picked, named '911 Inspection Dimensions - <folder> - <date>.txt'.
Each part gets its part number, work order, size and FAB DIM from the title block, then its dimension list.
Anything the reader was unsure about is flagged with CHECK so you can eyeball it against the drawing.

fields.label: Default PDF folder
fields.description: Folder the pick-a-folder dialog opens in. Leave blank to start wherever you were last.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
